desc: Compact and ergonomic. This "trapper style" lever-action features deluxe hardware with the superior fit and finish that you expect from Winchester Repeating Arms. The little "Trapper" is one of the most admired and useful rifles of the 19th century and continues to be popular with woodsmen, trappers, and traditional outdoorsmen in this century. This deluxe version is beautiful to handle and mechanically wonderful to use.
